findings: In `learner.overview`, the main meaning “bore or pierce through” and traditional tooth-in-hole explanation are supported, but the competing sound-element account makes this first-reading layer harder to follow and omits the visible 牙 component’s disputed earlier form, 耳. Keep the traditional construction up front; if mentioning the alternative, say that a Chu spelling is proposed to contain 耳 and 串 and that its reading and relation to 穿 remain disputed. Cite the supporting evidence.
